L4.zh: 一辆长身城市公交,十六乘四粒,车顶平坦,前面有风挡,两侧各三扇窗,尾部发动机面板,车底深色车轮。

L4.label: 首批
L4.prompt: A city bus sixteen studs long and four wide with a flat roof, a driver's windshield, three side windows per side, a rear engine panel and dark wheel blocks under the floor.
L4.zh: 一辆城市公交,长十六粒宽四粒,车顶平坦,驾驶位有风挡,每侧三扇侧窗,尾部有发动机面板,车底是深色车轮块。

L5.label: V1
L5.prompt: A complete shuttle bus: fourteen-by-four body, window band with a door outline at the rear, flat front glass, engine panel and black wheels under the floor line.
L5.zh: 一辆完整的穿梭巴士:十四乘四粒的车身,车窗带、尾部有车门轮廓,前面玻璃平坦,发动机面板,地板线下是黑色车轮。

L5.label: V2
L5.prompt: A complete city bus sixteen studs by four: soft-edged roof, front two-stud glass, four windows per side, front-side door frames, rear grille panel, arched black wheels with notched blocks and a frontal light bar.
L5.zh: 一辆完整的城市公交,十六乘四粒:车顶边缘圆润,前面是两粒宽的玻璃,每侧四扇窗,前侧有门框,尾部格栅面板,拱形黑色车轮配缺口轮块,前面还有一条灯带。

L5.label: V3
L5.prompt: A whole transit bus with a sixteen-by-four shell, rounded roof corners, wide front windshield, quad side windows, outlined sliding doors, engine grille at the rear, black wheeled arches notched under, plus a cross light bar ahead.
L5.zh: 一辆完整的公交,十六乘四粒的壳体,车顶圆角,前面风挡宽大,每侧四扇窗,滑动门有轮廓线,尾部有进气格栅,下面是带缺口的黑色轮拱,前面还有一条横向灯带。

L5.label: V4
L5.prompt: A finished single-deck bus: sixteen-long four-wide body, curved roof edges, two-stud windshield, four side windows each way, drawn front doors, rear engine grille, black arch wheels with notches, and a front light strip.
L5.zh: 一辆成型的单层巴士:车身长十六粒宽四粒,车顶边缘带弧度,两粒宽的风挡,每侧四扇侧窗,前面画有车门,尾部发动机格栅,带缺口的黑色拱形车轮,前面还有一条灯带。

L5.label: V5
L5.prompt: A detailed city bus with sixteen-by-four framing, rounded roofline, broad windshield, four flank windows, sliding-door outlines, grilled rear panel, notched black wheel arches and a forward light bar.
L5.zh: 一辆精致的城市公交,十六乘四粒的框架,车顶线圆润,风挡宽大,侧面四扇窗,滑动门有轮廓线,尾部面板带格栅,黑色轮拱带缺口,前面还有一条灯带。

L5.label: 首批
L5.prompt: A full single-deck city bus: a long box body sixteen by four studs with rounded roof edges, a two-stud windshield at the front, four passenger windows along each side, sliding door outlines at the front side, a flat rear panel with an engine grille, black wheel arches with notched wheel blocks, and a light bar across the front.
L5.zh: 一辆完整的单层城市公交:长方箱式车身十六乘四粒,车顶边缘圆润,前面是两粒宽的风挡,每侧四扇乘客窗,前侧有滑动门轮廓,平坦的车尾面板带发动机格栅,黑色轮拱配缺口轮块,前面还有一条横贯的灯带。
